# Motion

`motion.js` is the unmodified browser bundle of **Motion 14.1.0**, licensed under
MIT. Its license is preserved in `MOTION-LICENSE.md`.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/motion@14.1.0/dist/motion.js

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/motion/v/14.1.0

The concert uses `animate()` sequences, `stagger()` and spring transitions for
finite title/set reveals. Audio, scene drawing and animation lifetime remain
controlled by `music-stage.js`. This local copy is precached for offline use.
